_setup_notes: BEFORE USING: Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your actual system username in all paths below.
Mac/Linux users: replace C:/Users/YOUR_USERNAME with /Users/YOUR_USERNAME or use ~ where supported.
Windows users: replace YOUR_USERNAME with your Windows login name (e.g. casey.kaut or hank.williams).
After editing, copy this file to: ~/.claude/settings.json (Mac/Linux) or %USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json (Windows)
Also copy hooks/gemini-fallback.sh to ~/.claude/hooks/ — the PostToolUse Bash hook below depends on it.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "Mountain Lodge Telluride — Claude session started. Property profile and org standards loaded."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "WORKFLOW REMINDER: For any request to build, implement, create, add, or develop a feature — always follow this sequence: (1) /superpowers:brainstorm to clarify requirements, (2) /superpowers:write-plan to produce an implementation plan, (3) /superpowers:execute-plan to build it using sub-agents. After code is written, run /simplify to clean it up."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "A file was just written or edited. Before finishing this task, run /simplify on the changed file to review it for quality, duplication, and efficiency."}}'
